meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把 GitHub issue 按根本原因合并成少量“plan-master”主问题,每类对应一个修复计划;子问题会被标准评论重定向并关闭,新来的 bug 会追加到主问题。修复时一个 PR 打包关闭整类子问题,目标是 open issues == open plans。
howto.when: 当仓库有约 20 个以上 open issue 且疑似同因,或你要求整理 issue、从 issue 做计划,或询问新 bug 归属时触发。少于约 15 个时按普通方式处理。

say.text: 新 bug #123 归入哪个 plan?帮我追加进去。
为 plan-02 准备 PR,列出所有子 issue 的 Closes #N。
say.note: 合并后 GitHub 自动关闭这些子 issue。

howto.what_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into a few plan-master issues; close children with a standard redirect, append new bugs to masters, and ship one PR per cluster that closes all children. End state: open issues == open plans.
howto.when_en: Use when 20+ open issues share likely root causes, or when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster issues, build a plan, or route a new bug into an existing plan. Skip if fewer than ~15 issues or all are independent.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues by root cause and open a plan-master per cluster.
say_en.note: Claude reads all, creates masters, closes children.

say_en.text: Which plan does new bug #123 belong to? Fold it in.
say_en.note: Claude matches a master, posts a Round N comment, closes the new issue.

say_en.text: Prepare a PR for plan-02 with Closes #N for every child issue.
